name: [UPD] THE WRAITH: SURVIVAL
desc:
⚠️WARNING!
Some visuals in-game may include:
Loud noises & Flashing lights (EPILEPSY)

The government sent you to this isolated forest on a classified location as a part of a containment project. Subject 1 was caught long time ago, however Subject 2 still remains and needs to be captured.

Are you going to capture Subject 2 and stop all of this madness... or realize you were a part of it all along?
